title: IDS vs IPS: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Think of airport security. One system just watches and raises the alarm. Another stops you at the gate.

scenes.heading: Screening
scenes.narration: Both look for bad traffic, but they act differently. An I D S sits beside the traffic and only alerts. An I P S sits in the path and can block. Both match signatures, odd behaviour and protocol rules. The price is that an I P S adds delay.

items.real: Out of band, uses SPAN or tap

scenes.heading: Compare
scenes.narration: Here's the difference at a glance. An I D S sits out of band, and an I P S sits inline. An I D S only alerts, but an I P S can block. And an I P S adds a little delay.
